_comment: Words that were merged or renamed, and what they became. A saved book, notebook or learned word that
names one still reads, as its successor (Vocabulary.word); a player's learned set is carried over on
joining. Add to this and never remove from it.
A word retired into several (`phrases`) reads as them in its place: `rising_north` is `north rising`. A
learned one becomes each of them, and a page of it keeps its name and reads as the phrase.
A derived word renamed is listed by its whole id (`minecraft:birch_checked`): it is no longer derived, and a
retired name of ours never reaches another namespace's word of that name (`drowned`).
